Time-to-event statistics offered in the module

Source: R/surv_stats.R
ttni_surv_time_choices.Rd

mean_sd is a descriptive summary of AVAL (one row). The remaining names are tern::surv_time() statistics, shown in tern's native order. quantiles and range are labeled Q1, Q3 and Min, Max. Separate median / median_ci rows are not offered; use median_ci_3d so median and 95% CI stay on one line.

Usage

ttni_surv_time_choices()

Value

A named character vector (label = stat).
